 By BVM Sportsdesk, 14h ago Main Story With two matches left in the 2026-27 league phase, Matchday 5 could reshape the race for quarterfinal byes and knockout-playoff spots. Key clashes include Arsenal vs. OL Lyonnes and Chelsea vs. Paris Saint-Germain, while teams near the bottom need points to keep their tournament hopes alive.
 By the Numbers 18 clubs are competing in the league phase.
 4 teams advance directly to the quarterfinals; 8 more reach the knockout playoffs, while the bottom 6 are eliminated.
 OL Lyonnes and Barcelona have 10 points apiece; OL Lyonnes lead on goal difference.
 OL Lyonnes have scored 20 goals in 4 matches; Chelsea have conceded 0.
 Marie-Antoinette Katoto leads the scoring race with 7 goals.
 Yes, But Arsenal arrive with momentum after drawing Barcelona 1-1, but OL Lyonnes have been more productive, including a 6-0 win over Juventus. Chelsea’s defense has been flawless, yet their attack needs to convert chances: they managed 32 shots but only 6 on target in a scoreless draw with BK Häcken.
 State of Play Wednesday’s featured matchups: Chelsea vs. PSG and Manchester City vs. BK Häcken.
 Thursday’s headline game is Arsenal vs. OL Lyonnes; Barcelona face Servette, and Benfica meet Roma.
 PSG sit 10th with 5 points and will be without injured Sakina Karchaoui for the rest of the league phase.
 Juventus, Roma, and tournament debutants Inter Milan are among the teams under pressure to climb the table.
 What’s Next Results this week will sharpen the standings before the final league-phase round. Juventus’ meeting with 17th-place OH Leuven is especially important after their 6-0 loss to OL Lyonnes, while Benfica vs. Roma could shift the teams’ positions.
 Bottom Line With qualification and elimination both in reach, every point matters. The top sides are chasing direct quarterfinal berths, while teams lower in the table have little room left to recover.
